description:
Several existing platforms already switch or report an execution engine through ad-hoc keys. Move them onto the core execution_engines capability so the same values mean the same thing everywhere.

Work (per ADR D3 naming and class rules):
1. pg-duckdb: `force_execution` (default true, pg_duckdb.py:125,190-191) becomes engines duckdb (delegated, the current default) and postgres (standard); force_execution stays a deprecated alias.
2. dask-df: `use_distributed`/`scheduler_address` (dask_df.py:91-92,129,236-256) become engines threads (standard) and distributed; scheduler_address stays a connection option. Fix the docs/code default mismatch (docs say false, code says True) as part of the decision.
3. Databricks: Photon is a warehouse/cluster property, not selectable per run; declare photon (native-vectorized) and standard with selectable=false and record observed from warehouse.enable_photon (databricks/adapter.py:775) with observed_source.
4. Velox (Spark + Gluten): declare velox (native-vectorized, selectable=false) and record observed from the existing EXPLAIN probe (velox_active, velox.py:240-246).
5. Each adapter returns an ExecutionEngineReceipt from get_platform_info; docs list the engines from the manifest.
